Final categorization: OK  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that explicitly implements national-scale (Belgium) spatial downscaling of future land-use projections using the GLOBIO 4 model. Its primary objective is to produce high-resolution (10 m and 100 m) LULC maps from coarse global LUH2 data under three distinct SSP-RCP scenarios (SSP1xRCP2.6, SSP3xRCP6.0, SSP5xRCP8.5), satisfying the requirement of ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison. The study reports quantitative accuracy metrics (overall accuracy: 0.90–0.98, Kappa: 0.90–0.97, RSR: 0.11–0.33) and validates outputs against independent datasets (Copernicus Global Land Service). Mapped LULC projections are central outputs, and the modeling is spatially explicit. All core inclusion criteria are met, and none of the exclusion criteria apply.)
